title: Визит к врачу Вики  (Visit to Vika's Doctor)

segments.t: The next morning, Max tracks down Vika's doctor, Elena Vladimirovna, at the clinic and claims Vika sent him to pick up her test results. However, Vika has already anticipated his move.
Она просила меня забрать её анализы.
А меня Виктория просила ничего не говорить.
Дело в том, что это мой ребёнок.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Hello, Elena Vladimirovna.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Elena' before landing on 'hello'.
'Hello.' the doctor brings out the contrast between 'hello' and 'hello' in a few short words.
'I am Maxim Lavrov.' Max anchors the line on 'I', while 'proper name' completes the thought.
'My wife is being monitored by you.' Russians say 'by me' or 'with us' where English says 'I have' or 'we have', without needing a separate word for 'have'.
Она просила меня забрать её анализы.
'She asked me to pick up her test results.' The meaning hinges on 'she' working together with 'test results' in spoken Russian.
'Yes, and what about it?' the doctor raises the pitch on 'what' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
А меня Виктория просила ничего не говорить.
'And Victoria asked me not to say anything.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'to speak'.
'To a man named Maxim Lavrov.' Notice how Russian expresses 'person' and 'proper name' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Forgive me, this is very important.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'forgive' before landing on 'important'.
'I need to know the truth.' Max brings out the contrast between 'to me' and 'needed' in a few short words.
'I cannot tell you anything.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'nothing' before landing on 'to say'.
Дело в том, что это мой ребёнок.

'The thing is that this is my child.' The grammar packs 'business' and 'child' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Она просила меня забрать её анализы.
А меня Виктория просила ничего не говорить.
Дело в том, что это мой ребёнок.
Refused an answer at the doctor's office door, Max refuses to give up and looks for another way into her prenatal class. Until next time!
